strongest_access_route.public_researcher_route: Request physical v.1 and v.2 through a home library's ILL service using OCLC 1124979819, call number, and volume barcodes; alternatively seek staff-mediated onsite access.

relationship_to_2013.volume_boundary_evidence: 2013 page 615 opens a new named Sarybay episode immediately after 2018 volume 1's cataloged 614-page extent.
relationship_to_2013.pagination_model: 2018 v.1 = 2013 pp.1-614; 2018 v.2 = 2013 pp.615-1172 (558 pages) plus 20 pages of new volume preliminaries; 614 + 558 + 20 = 1192.
relationship_to_2013.assessment: Moderate-to-high confidence that the 2018 set republishes/splits the 2013 core text; exact textual identity remains unproved without inspecting 2018 scans.
relationship_to_2013.estimated_new_poetic_lines_qualification: Working hypothesis only, based on pagination and section-boundary evidence.
relationship_to_2013.missing_line_claim_note: The reported 104,427 missing Seytek lines exceeds the 2013 edition's statement of 84,697 lines for Karalaev's recorded Seytek and requires source-accounting review; extracted source rows and printed verse lines are not necessarily equivalent.

conclusion: No public full scan located. Columbia/ReCAP has a currently available complete v.1-2 set and is the strongest physical-access route. Its scan service is limited to a chapter/article up to 10% and requires authenticated eligibility. Pagination and an exact section-boundary match provide moderate-to-high confidence that this is a two-volume repackaging of the 2013 text, with no current evidence of additional poetic lines.
